title: RAGSentinel: Certifiable Geometric Consensus for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23965v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models by grounding responses in external documents, but it also exposes a critical security vulnerability: adversarial documents injected into the knowledge database can enter the context window and steer the model toward targeted incorrect answers. Existing post-retrieval defenses rely on instruction following, parametric knowledge, or text-level consistency, all of which can be imitated or optimized against by adaptive attackers. We propose RAGSentinel, a training-free, label-free defense for black-box RAG systems. RAGSentinel uses a surrogate encoder to measure query-conditioned hidden-state shifts induced by retrieved documents, removes shared topic directions, and filters poisoned documents as geometric outliers from a robust majority consensus. translated_title: RAGSentinel：可认证的几何共识用于稳健的检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将响应基于外部文档来提高大型语言模型的事实性，但它也暴露了一个关键的安全漏洞：注入知识数据库的对抗性文档可以进入上下文窗口，并引导模型产生目标性的错误答案。现有的检索后防御依赖于指令遵循、参数化知识或文本级一致性，这些都可能被自适应攻击者模仿或优化。我们提出了RAGSentinel，一种无需训练、无需标签的防御方法，适用于黑盒RAG系统。RAGSentinel使用一个替代编码器来测量由检索文档引起的查询条件隐藏状态偏移，去除共享主题方向，并将有毒文档作为几何离群点从稳健的多数共识中过滤掉。我们证明，在诚实多数假设和表示级分离条件下，RAGSentinel能够有效抵御此类攻击。
tldr: RAGSentinel通过几何共识和替代编码器，无需训练或标签即可在黑盒RAG系统中检测并过滤对抗性文档，从而提供可认证的鲁棒性防御。
en_tdlr: RAGSentinel provides a certifiable, training-free defense for black-box RAG systems by using geometric consensus and surrogate encoders to detect and filter adversarial documents.
